component.name: GitStream
component.summary: Desktop Git client with a non-blocking UI

description.p: GitStream is a standalone Git GUI focused on everyday work: commits, branches, push/pull and diff viewing — without UI freezes or needless complexity.

ul.li: Stage / unstage / discard changes, including partial (hunk/line) staging
Commit dialog with per-file checkboxes, amend and Commit & Push
Commit graph with branches, tags, HEAD and remote tracking
Unified and side-by-side diff with a toggle
Pull / push / fetch / clone with remote selection

screenshot.caption: Main window: commit graph, files and diff

description.p: Version synchronization, 0BSD license, Flathub packaging groundwork.
